newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Palestinian ends hunger strike in Cyprus.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian ends hunger strike in Cyprus.

text.p: A Palestinian jailed in Cyprus for a bungled car bomb attack against the Israeli embassy has ended an 11-day hunger strike after he collapsed, police said on Tuesday.
"He ended his hunger strike and took food at midday Monday," a Cypriot police spokesman told Reuters, referring to Omar Hawillo, 36.

Hawillo, jailed for 15 years for his part in the bomb attack against the Israeli embassy which killed three people in Cyprus in 1988, was protesting at the United Nation's not recognising him as a political refugee and because he could not find a country willing to accept him now he is free.
Hawillo collapsed in his detention quarters on Sunday night and police guards took him to hospital where he was put on an intravenous drip and later discharged.
Hawillo was released from prison last August. Ten months later, he is without travel documents and still in detention pending deportation to a country willing to accept him.
It was never clarified which faction was responsible for the bungled attack.
